in_marathi.name: Nirakar
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nirakar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hindu mythology, Nirakar refers to the formless, shapeless aspect of God. The name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'nirakaar' which means 'without form'. It is a revered name in Hinduism, representing the divine presence that transcends all forms.
